subject: Weekend plan and timing
text:
Dear colleague,

I wanted to outline my weekend plan in case any item needs attention. I intend to handle the revised schedule on Saturday morning, then review notes before noon. Because the updated deadline moved earlier by two hours, I will prioritize the sign-off document and share the summary by midday. Sunday will remain open for travel, so I will not be checking messages after lunch. If something requires a faster response than I can manage before Monday morning, please flag it today so we can adjust. I appreciate your understanding of the current timing overall.

Best wishes,
